subtasks:

  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - 0.15

  weight: 0.7
phases:

  type: approach
  generator: arc_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance

    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:

    - 0.0
    - 0.15
    tolerance: 0.005
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    approach_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.08
      - 0.25
      default: 0.15
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
    arc_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.03
      - 0.15
      default: 0.08
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.arc_height
        mode: replace
    speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.5
      default: 0.3
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: approach_high

  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.005
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    descent_speed:

      range:
